name: Puzzle Deck
summary:
PuzzleDeck is for people who love to build. Pick up a hand-crafted tin toy puzzle, piece it together with your hands in the space in front of you, and finish each one with a reveal that only spatial computing can deliver. A Great White Shark, life-sized, right there in the room with you.
